title: Run balance scenarios without rendering
action: Add a headless scenario runner using the real fixed-tick simulator and declarative legal construction/action sequences.
player_value: Make large-seed economy comparisons reproducible before changing costs or rates.
acceptance: One command runs at least 100 seeds and exports first Cycles delivery, first Cash, time to research, stuck runs and time to goal; scenario actions obey normal placement/payment rules.

title: Record reproducible full-run action replays
action: Store initial rules/seed and ordered player commands with tick numbers; replay them against the same rules version.
player_value: Turn a player-reported network failure into an exact reproducible fixture.
acceptance: Replay an opening, reroute, sweep response and undo sequence twice; state digests match at every recorded checkpoint.

title: Apply simulation commands at tick boundaries
action: Queue validated commands and apply each once at a specified simulation tick, leaving hover/camera feedback immediate.
player_value: Remove frame-timing variation from placements, payments and defenses.
acceptance: A timestamped command sequence run at30,60 and144 presentation frames/sec produces the same balances, routes and threat outcomes.

title: Give city, contracts, threats and packet loss separate RNG streams
action: Derive subsystem seeds from the run seed and persist their independent state.
player_value: Keep a map and existing packet outcomes stable when unrelated contract-generation logic changes.
acceptance: Increasing contract draws must leave city layout and a fixed packet-loss test unchanged; all streams survive Continue.
relation: New; extends B23 without duplicating its missing-state fix

title: Extract a presentation-independent simulation core
action: Move resource, graph, packet and threat state updates behind a core with explicit step/command/state interfaces.
player_value: Support rapid balance testing and future UI work without coupling game rules to the scene tree.
acceptance: A scripted 100-second run produces equivalent outcomes through the normal scene and a core-only headless runner.

title: Fuzz legal action sequences against state invariants
action: Generate build/connect/toggle/remove/undo/save/continue sequences and check graph validity, references, resource conservation and route legality.
player_value: Catch combinations that hand-written happy-path probes miss.
acceptance: A fixed seed suite completes thousands of legal actions with no negative reserves, dangling references, loops or occupied-road routes; failing sequences shrink to a replay.

title: Check bounded routing against an independent oracle
action: Compare A* to BFS for existence within the step budget, and to a direction-aware shortest-path oracle when turn cost matters.
player_value: Detect feasible roads rejected by the routing heuristic and poor paths before players encounter them.
acceptance: Curated chokepoints and seeded street fixtures agree on path existence at exact length limits; every admitted route is valid.
relation: Refines T30; merge with that item instead of counting separately

title: Lint the game-definition tables
action: Validate shared IDs, resources, sizes, costs, recipes, unlocks, district mappings, colors and glyphs at import or startup.
player_value: Prevent an added structure from shipping with a missing price, resource or visual identity.
acceptance: Deliberately missing protocol/recipe/resource IDs fail with clear diagnostics; the current complete definitions pass.

title: Create a repeatable simulation performance budget
action: Benchmark fixed seeds at several network and in-transit packet sizes, reporting tick-time distribution and allocations.
player_value: Keep late-game networks responsive as content grows.
acceptance: Benchmark fixtures with100,500 and1000 structures publish p50/p95 tick cost and peak packet counts; regressions above the documented budget fail the performance check.

title: Batch identical in-transit packet state
action: Represent packets that share resource/value/route/timing as counts or compact batches; render a bounded representative sample.
player_value: Reduce memory and CPU costs while retaining readable traffic and correct reserves.
acceptance: Dense fixtures match the scalar simulator's resource totals and seeded loss policy within a defined statistical/deterministic model while reducing allocations and tick time.

title: Bound catch-up work after long frames
action: Specify a wall-time catch-up policy and limit work per presentation frame; retain or explicitly discard excess elapsed time according to the run mode.
player_value: Avoid multi-second input freezes after a stalled frame.
acceptance: Inject a5-second frame stall; input remains responsive and all deadlines, boosts, sweeps and production advance consistently under the documented policy.

title: Index footprint occupancy directly
action: Maintain a tile-to-node index updated atomically with construction and undo; share authoritative building data with placement and routing.
player_value: Make map interactions scale better than repeated full-node scans.
acceptance: Queries match the reference scan after build/remove/undo/load, and route benchmark cost improves at500+ nodes.
relation: Refines T32; merge with that item instead of counting separately

title: Rebuild network structure only when topology changes
action: Cache parent/child adjacency and connection traversal behind a topology revision; continue recalculating only state-dependent load/threat fields.
player_value: Save per-tick work in large stable networks.
acceptance: An idle1000-node graph stops rebuilding adjacency every tick; toggles and quarantine still update reachability at the correct tick.
relation: Refines T32; merge with that item instead of counting separately

title: Reject disconnected road searches before full A*
action: Maintain reusable street-component information, then account for temporary footprint/lane blockers when deciding whether a full route search is necessary.
player_value: Make clearly impossible long links respond immediately.
acceptance: Disconnected-city fixtures return a blocked result without exploring the whole map; dynamic blockers never cause a valid route to be rejected by stale component data.

title: Use a proper priority queue for the route frontier
action: Replace linear minimum scans and repeated array membership checks with a heap plus explicit deterministic tie-breaks.
player_value: Reduce route-preview stalls on long or crowded paths.
acceptance: Long-route fixtures return equivalent or better valid paths with lower measured search time; identical inputs always select the same route.

title: Make resource precision an explicit rule
action: Use integer subunits or a defined quantization policy for fractional Cash, fuel, timers and accumulated production; convert to display units at the UI boundary.
player_value: Keep long sessions and repeated fractional transactions consistent.
acceptance: Million-step fractional-production fixtures stay within the declared error bound; saving and loading does not change conserved quantities.

title: Add an inspectable single-tick planning control
action: Permit advancing one fixed simulation tick or one simulated second while planning pause is active, with updated packet/threat inspection.
player_value: Help players understand exactly when a resource moves or a defense takes effect.
acceptance: Each advance updates all simulation timers once, leaves camera/UI usable, and never opens or bypasses a blocking modal.
relation: New; builds on the planning-pause fix without duplicating it

title: Compare candidate network changes in a disposable simulation fork
action: Run a bounded preview of two candidate configurations from the same copied state and report reserves, delivered resources and failure risk.
player_value: Let players assess an expensive change against their actual network.
acceptance: Comparisons use matched random streams, never mutate the live run, and label assumptions/horizon; cancelling returns unchanged resources and routes.
relation: New; distinct from the construction-cost preview in T25

title: Make construction and replacement graph changes transactional
action: Stage a proposed graph, complete route/cost validation, then commit it once with a reversible before/after record.
player_value: Keep a failed multi-part construction from leaving an incomplete network.
acceptance: Failure at any validation step changes neither graph, resources nor history; accepted replacements undo to the exact prior state.
relation: Refines T28/T29 and SIM-N01; merge rather than add an independent count

title: Offer consistent ordinary-run speed controls
action: Add a small explicit speed selector using simulation time rather than presentation delta; display it beside pause.
player_value: Let players slow a difficult defense or accelerate a stable production wait.
acceptance: At0.5x/1x/2x, production, packets, deadlines, boosts and threats scale together while camera/UI behavior stays constant; disable inappropriate speeds during blocking screens.
relation: New; ordinary-run interaction, beyond sandbox configuration

title: Apply manual commands to a whole selected branch
action: Preview branch members and allow explicit grouped enable/disable/output-limit commands with a clear aggregate consequence.
player_value: Reduce repeated late-game clicking without requiring an automation scripting system.
acceptance: A selected branch applies a command only to listed eligible descendants; unsupported nodes are identified, and cancellation makes no state change.
relation: New; distinct from conditional automation policies N14

title: Let players name important structures
action: Store an optional player label and display it consistently in inspections, contracts/alerts where relevant and selection navigation.
player_value: Make large networks easier to remember and discuss.
acceptance: Labels survive Continue, update immediately and do not replace the canonical type or node ID used by simulation and replays.

title: Support placement defaults for repeated builds
action: Allow a tool's initial output limit or disabled-at-construction setting to be selected before placing several producers.
player_value: Avoid placing a large batch at full output and immediately revisiting every structure to throttle it.
acceptance: New structures inherit the shown preset; preset selection changes no existing structures and remains visible while the tool is armed.

title: Allow limited route waypoint constraints
action: Let a player pin one or more legal street cells for a link, then route and price the combined path before committing.
player_value: Make congested road use a deliberate planning choice instead of relying entirely on one automatic path.
acceptance: Each segment respects map/occupancy/lane rules, the combined route respects total length, and removing a waypoint restores normal automatic routing.

title: Expose occupied street-lane cells during routing
action: Add an optional routing overlay showing available and occupied physical lane slots, distinct from packets-per-second capacity.
player_value: Explain why a nearby link cannot use an otherwise visible road.
acceptance: At0–4 occupied lanes each road cell shows the correct count; build/remove/reroute/undo updates it immediately and available cells agree with route admission.
relation: New; distinct from effective throughput display T26
